top_signals.title: Russia expands shadow LNG fleet to beat EU crackdown
top_signals.summary: Growing number of ships will help Moscow continue exporting liquefied natural gas when sanctions tighten next year
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: HSBC's Elhedery on Buybacks and Vision for Bank Overhaul
top_signals.summary: HSBC Chief Executive Officer Georges Elhedery speaks to Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua about the bank's announcement of a fresh stock buyback as it reports second-quarter earnings that beat estimates, despite China’s crackdown on cross-border wealth flows. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hackers steal 31,000 records identifying people behind Liechtenstein companies, foundations
top_signals.summary: A cyberattack compromised tens of thousands of records related to companies, foundations and trusts in Liechtenstein, prompting the government to to form a “crisis unit” to address the breach.
